newsitem.title: UK: Low & Bonar profits hit by stg strength.
newsitem.headline: Low & Bonar profits hit by stg strength.

text.p: British packaging, plastics and specialised textiles group Low & Bonar Plc said on Monday that the strength of the pound and competitive trading conditions adversely affected profits in the first half of this year.
Pretax profits at the firm slipped to 21.3 million in the six months to May 31, 1997 from 26.2 million previously.
This was below analysts' forecasts of a 24.5 million profit and the shares dropped 25-1/2p to stand at 256p by 0753 GMT.
Low & Bonar noted that the strong pound hurt the translation of overseas profits and the transactional effect on trading margins.
It estimated that the currency factor hit profits by three million stg.
The company expects that the competitive trading environment, particularly in packaging will continue and also said its performance will be affected by the strength of the pound.
